name: Round Scholar Pencil
description: Make an indelible impression on your customers and supporters with our Scholar pencil. This 7.37" x 0.30" wooden pencil has a classic rounded design with a No. 2 lead fill, silver colored ferrule and custom color eraser. Head back to school or the office with this indispensable promotional item. Select from a wide range of colors and shades and add your school, sports team, organizational or company logo, emblem or message to create a bold branded gift or giveaway that's kind to your budget and bottom line.hexagonal design also available.
